description: Source code for self-test context and executor classes in the oeqa framework, managing test setup, execution, and environment configuration.

classes.name: NonConcurrentTestSuite
classes.description: Custom unittest test suite for running tests sequentially with setup and teardown.

classes.name: OESelftestTestContext
classes.description: Context class managing environment setup, test loading, and execution for oe-selftest.

classes.name: OESelftestTestContextExecutor
classes.description: Executor class for configuring and running oe-selftest via command-line interface.

methods.name: removebuilddir
methods.description: Removes build directory, waiting for lock files and optionally using autobuilder.

methods.name: setup_builddir
methods.description: Sets up a new build directory for selftest, copying configs and initializing git.

methods.name: prepareSuite
methods.description: Prepares a test suite, possibly with concurrency support.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Runs the configured tests, possibly on a specific machine.

methods.name: _get_available_machines
methods.description: Discovers available machine configurations from layer files.

methods.name: _get_cases_paths
methods.description: Retrieves paths to test case directories.

methods.name: _process_args
methods.description: Processes command-line arguments and sets up test parameters.

methods.name: _check_presence_meta_selftest
methods.description: Ensures the meta-selftest layer is present and added.

methods.name: _add_layer_libs
methods.description: Adds layer library directories to sys.path.

methods.name: _pre_run
methods.description: Performs pre-run environment checks and setup.

methods.name: get_json_result_dir
methods.description: Determines directory for JSON test results.

methods.name: get_result_id
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for test results.

methods.name: _internal_run
methods.description: Executes the test suite and logs results.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main entry point for executing tests with argument processing.

methods.name: register_commands
methods.description: Registers CLI commands for test execution and listing.
